title: Small-Group Sightseeing Tour of Montreal
includes: Complimentary pick up from downtown hotels when requested at least 24 hours in advance.
Commented driving tour by an accredited bilingual tour guide
Small size group (8 - 16 pers.) in comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle
Visit of Notre-Dame Basilica (we only stop for a picture) (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
This experience includes several attractions. Guests will be getting on and off the van frequently. It is not suitable for persons with limited mobility.

While children and special need individuals are welcomed on our tour. In case of any disturbance that make other guests uncomfortable, interfere with guides' commentary or rise a security concern, participants may be asked to leave the tour. No refund will be granted.
Not suitable for travelers with limited mobility
policies: COVID-19 prevention measures: Wearing a face mask is highly recommended in the vehicle and in closed spaces during visits, but not obligatory. Wearing gloves is highly recommended inside the vehicle. Our guides/drivers who have tested for COVID19 and are positive, or have been in contact with a confirmed case will not be allowed to do any tours. Some activities/visits might not be doable due to 3rd party temporary closure.
In case of special events or roads closure tour/attractions could be modified without prior notice.
Smoking, e-cigarettes and alcohol consumption is strictly prohibited inside the vehicle
No luggage or bags in general can be left on our unattended vehicles during visits or lunch break. Anything, you bring on with you must by curried on while not on the vehicle.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
A fulfilling tour of Montreal in 3 hours! You will get to see Mount Royal, Westmount, St. Joseph’s Oratory, Downtown as well as Saint Helen's Island, Old Montreal and waterfront.

Your tour will begin with a drive through Downtown and Mount Royal via the upscale neighborhoods of Westmount and then visit the famous St. Joseph’s Oratory, largest church in Canada. We shall then drive through what is still consider as more French neighborhoods of the city and cross the Jacques Cartier bridge to the site of the unforgettable expo 67 at Jean-Drapeau Park. From St. Helen’s Island you would appreciate a breathtaking view of the Montreal Skyline before seeing the F1 Circuit Gilles Villeneuve. Arriving at Old Montreal area will conclude the half day tour as it ends nearby the prestigious Notre-Dame Basilica.
